reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 2 points better, in a game of about 226 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Nuggets.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 50 times in 100; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.
